name: ROAS vs MER Profitability Matrix
description: Why in-platform ROAS is an accounting illusion and how blended MER protects cash flow.
primary_equation: MER = Total Net Revenue / Total Media Spend
contribution_equation: Contribution Margin = Net Revenue - (COGS + Media Spend + Delivery + Returns)
key_insights: Platforms take 100% credit for conversions they touched, leading to 20-35% duplicated attribution.
A 4x ROAS on paper can be cash-flow negative when return rates exceed 20% in COD markets.
Blended MER provides a tamper-proof ground truth across all acquisition channels.
